global.intent: A welcoming textile repair workshop where material detail rewards inspection and all actions remain clear.
global.primaryTask: Understand the four offerings, inspect the repair pilot, and preview the interest form.
global.deploymentMode: standalone specification; no live site or backend is included
global.valueStatus: Design-selected starting values, unless a field is explicitly an API or standards constraint.

claims.materialComposition: illustrative names; no physical composition verification
claims.environmentalImpact: no recycled, bio-based, regenerative, or impact certification claim
claims.physics: bounded illustrative simulation; no measured fabric calibration
claims.performance: budgets are proposed targets, not results

render.idleRenderPolicy: invalidate on change; stop after settling
render.backgroundTabPolicy: pause and reset time accumulator on resume

typography.fontSubset: Latin plus characters actually used; preserve required glyphs

accessibility.reducedMotionPolicy: static state changes; no inertia, parallax, wind, or curtain animation
accessibility.forcedColorsPolicy: native DOM borders and text; decorative textures hidden

T0.name: semantic baseline
T0.description: DOM, CSS, optional static images; every task remains available

T1.name: selective material view
T1.description: one shared canvas; mapped surfaces and modeled edges/stitches; future renderer

T2.name: explicit close inspection
T2.description: one selected swatch only; no whole-page fiber simulation

sources.title: Irawan and Marschner 2012
sources.finding: Woven appearance depends on fiber reflection, yarn geometry, and weave pattern across viewing and lighting angles.
sources.interpretation: Model topology, yarn, and fibers separately. The selected dimensions below are authored values, not fitted measurements.

sources.title: Yu et al 2025 ray wave hybrid cloth
sources.finding: This research models reflection and transmission using simulation-informed ray and wave methods, including variation among plies.
sources.interpretation: Use it to understand the limits of simple cloth shading. This pack does not implement or claim equivalence to that model.

sources.title: Filament materials cloth model
sources.finding: Cloth shading treats sheen separately and provides specific guidance for dark velvet and ordinary cloth.
sources.interpretation: Use directional grazing response to distinguish materials. Filament and Three.js parameter values are not interchangeable.

sources.title: Three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial
sources.finding: Defines sheen, anisotropy, iridescence, and other physical material controls, with added rendering cost.
sources.interpretation: Map named shading fields to this API. Use r187 thickness minimum and maximum fields, not the deprecated range property.

sources.title: Three.js MeshStandardMaterial
sources.finding: Normal and bump shading differ from geometry displacement; displacement moves vertices.
sources.interpretation: Keep silhouettes, thickness, protruding stitches, and lifted edges in geometry. Use maps for remaining small-scale detail.

sources.title: Three.js color management
sources.finding: Color inputs and outputs require explicit color-space handling; numeric maps are non-color data.
sources.interpretation: Mark base color and sheen color as sRGB, numeric maps as NoColorSpace, and work in Linear-sRGB.

sources.title: Khronos sheen extension
sources.finding: Sheen color occupies RGB; sheen roughness is sampled from alpha.
sources.interpretation: Export separate color and numeric texture views. Retain the exact channel metadata in the asset receipt.

sources.title: Khronos anisotropy extension
sources.finding: Anisotropy direction is encoded in red and green, strength in blue, with a defined tangent space.
sources.interpretation: Preserve UV orientation and tangents. Test rotated fabric under fixed lighting before accepting a material.

sources.title: Macklin Muller Chentanez XPBD 2016
sources.finding: XPBD introduces compliance and accumulated constraint multipliers to address timestep and iteration coupling in ordinary PBD.
sources.interpretation: Use the distance-constraint kernel for optional drape work. Tune and test the complete solver; the kernel alone is not a cloth simulation.

sources.title: W3C dragging movements
sources.finding: Dragging needs an equivalent single-pointer operation without dragging; keyboard access is a separate requirement.
sources.interpretation: Provide click or tap selection followed by placement controls, alongside keyboard controls.

sources.title: W3C animation from interactions
sources.finding: Nonessential interaction-triggered motion can be disabled; this particular criterion is Level AAA.
sources.interpretation: Respect reduced motion throughout this design. Retain state changes with static visual and text feedback.

sources.title: W3C contrast minimum
sources.finding: Normal text generally needs 4.5:1 contrast and qualifying large text 3:1, with stated exceptions.
sources.interpretation: Put live text on opaque labels and test the rendered states, not only palette swatches.

sources.title: W3C target size minimum
sources.finding: The AA minimum is 24 by 24 CSS pixels subject to exceptions.
sources.interpretation: Select a more generous 48 by 48 CSS pixel project target. That chosen target does not establish whole-site conformance.

sources.title: MDN context loss testing
sources.finding: The extension can simulate context loss and restoration for testing.
sources.interpretation: Keep semantic controls and data outside the canvas. Verify fallback during an active task.

sources.title: Undercase Type Fraunces
sources.finding: The font repository publishes Fraunces under OFL-1.1.
sources.interpretation: Use for craft-manual headings; retain the actual downloaded font license and version in production.

sources.title: IBM Plex
sources.finding: IBM publishes the Plex family under the Open Font License.
sources.interpretation: Use Plex Sans for reading and Plex Mono for compact labels. Font files are specified, not bundled in this pack.

sources.title: Three.js KTX2Loader
sources.finding: The loader detects supported compressed formats and requires its transcoder files.
sources.interpretation: Use detectSupport before loading; ship transcoder assets with the same pinned Three.js release.

sources.title: Three.js r187 release
sources.finding: The release is available and the current documented material API includes r187 changes.
sources.interpretation: Pin three to 0.187.0 for a new implementation. Do not upgrade an existing repository without checking its lockfile and migration needs.

sources.title: MDN native modal dialog
sources.finding: showModal opens a dialog in the top layer and makes outside document content inert.
sources.interpretation: Use a native dialog, an explicit close control, a useful initial focus target, and tested focus restoration.

sources.title: Three.js DirectionalLight
sources.finding: The light direction follows its position and target rather than its rotation.
sources.interpretation: Set and add the light target explicitly. Keep light intensity values as authored renderer controls, not measured daylight.

sources.title: Attached Keep It Moving textile interface brief
sources.finding: Workshop setting, four textile offerings, tactile controls, cloth motion, close-up fibers, optional sound.
sources.interpretation: Preserve the material ambition while specifying topology, task behavior, fallbacks, and verification.

methods.name: Millimeters to runtime meters
methods.scope: Exact unit conversion; not a physical measurement.

methods.name: Yarn crossing clearance
methods.formula: rW = warpDiameterMm * flatteningZ / 2; rF = weftDiameterMm * flatteningZ / 2; zW = sign * (rW + gapMm/2); zF = -sign * (rF + gapMm/2)
methods.code: const sign = warpOver ? 1 : -1; const zWarp = sign * (warpDiameterMm * flatteningZ / 2 + gapMm / 2); const zWeft = -sign * (weftDiameterMm * flatteningZ / 2 + gapMm / 2);
methods.scope: Illustrative crossing samples only. Requires continuous curve/contact checks before use as yarn geometry.

methods.name: Weave pattern selection
methods.signature: warpOver(i: integer, j: integer, pattern: string): boolean
methods.formula: plain: (i+j) mod 2 = 0; twill-3x1: (i-j) mod 4 < 3; satin-5: (i-2*j) mod 5 != 0
methods.code: const mod = (x,n) => ((x%n)+n)%n; const over = pattern === "plain" ? mod(i+j,2)===0 : pattern === "twill-3x1" ? mod(i-j,4)<3 : mod(i-2*j,5)!==0;
methods.scope: Authored binary crossing pattern. Knit loops, lace, felt, and pile do not use this woven topology.

methods.name: Twisted ply centerline
methods.code: const theta = 2*Math.PI*(turnsPerMm*sMm + plyIndex/plyCount); const offsetN = radiusMm*Math.cos(theta); const offsetB = radiusMm*Math.sin(theta);
methods.scope: Sweep in a parallel-transport frame, not a fixed global frame. Check radius and strand overlap.

methods.name: Damped spring response
methods.signature: stepSpring(positionM, velocityMps, targetM, massKg, stiffnessNPerM, dampingNsPerM, dtS)
methods.code: const acceleration = (-k*(x-target)-c*v)/m; v += acceleration*dt; x += v*dt;
methods.scope: Semi-implicit Euler illustration with fixed substeps and bounds. These controller values are not measured denim mechanics.

methods.name: XPBD distance constraint
methods.signature: solveDistance(x0, x1, inverseMass0, inverseMass1, restLengthM, complianceMPerN, lambda, dtS)
methods.code: const a = compliance/(dt*dt); const dl = (-constraint-a*lambda)/(w0+w1+a); lambda += dl;
methods.scope: Distance-based bend surrogate, not calibrated angular cloth bending. Reset multipliers each substep; retain across solver iterations. No self-collision claim.

methods.name: Level of detail from projected yarn size
methods.formula: if !inspectionRequested or diameterPx<0.8 -> mapped surface; if 0.8<=diameterPx<2 -> modeled yarn; else modeled yarn plus bounded fiber detail
methods.scope: Design-selected perceptual thresholds; validate for shimmer and popping. No universal perceptual equivalence claim.

methods.name: Linear color and contrast
methods.scope: Use actual rendered foreground/background samples for textured states; a palette calculation alone is insufficient.

methods.name: Height-derived tangent normal
methods.scope: Shading detail only. Derivatives must use compatible physical units and correct image orientation.
